description: `test-genie`'s new Contracts phase (inserted between Structure and Standards) invokes `cli-health validate` via CLI subprocess and surfaces findings into the report; error findings fail the phase and warning findings produce warnings.

requirements.description: A new `Contracts` phase must be inserted into `test-genie`'s phase pipeline between the existing `Structure` phase and the existing `Standards` phase. This phase must invoke `cli-health validate <scenario>` exclusively via CLI subprocess (no raw HTTP or direct RPC calls from test-genie). The phase must capture stdout, stderr, and the exit code from the subprocess. The phase must be skippable via a per-scenario or global config flag (e.g., `contracts.enabled: false`).
requirements.title: Test-genie Contracts Phase Placement and CLI Subprocess Invocation

validation.notes: Given the test-genie phase list, assert Contracts appears at index position immediately after Structure and before Standards
Given contracts.enabled: false in config, the Contracts phase is skipped and produces no findings
Given a mocked subprocess returning exit code 0, the Contracts phase passes
Given a mocked subprocess returning exit code 1, the Contracts phase fails
Assert that no HTTP client or Qdrant/gRPC client is instantiated within the test-genie Contracts phase code
End-to-end: run `vrooli scenario test cli-health`; assert the phase order in the report output is Structure → Contracts → Standards
Run `vrooli scenario test development-toolchain-validator` with the Contracts phase active; assert the phase executes and produces a report section
Contracts validation is enforced as part of the standard test-genie pipeline, ensuring no scenario bypasses manifest validation

requirements.description: Within test-genie's Contracts phase, findings from `cli-health validate` must be mapped to phase outcomes as follows: any error-level finding (SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD, SCHEMA_TYPE_MISMATCH, UNRESOLVED_BINDING, ORPHAN_METHOD, STALE_OMISSION, or any future error-level code) must cause the Contracts phase to fail (phase status = FAILED, test-genie exits nonzero). Any warning-level finding must be surfaced in the phase report as a warning without failing the phase. The full structured finding list must appear in the test-genie report output.
requirements.title: Contracts Phase Finding-to-Phase-Outcome Mapping

validation.notes: Given subprocess output containing one ERROR-level finding JSON and exit code 1, the Contracts phase status is set to FAILED
Given subprocess output containing only WARNING-level findings and exit code 0, the Contracts phase status is PASSED with warnings listed
Given subprocess output containing both ERROR and WARNING findings, phase is FAILED and both finding types appear in the report
Given empty findings and exit code 0, the Contracts phase status is PASSED with no findings

Run `vrooli scenario test browser-automation-studio` with an intentionally invalid manifest; assert test-genie exits nonzero and the report section shows FAILED Contracts phase with the specific error finding
Run `vrooli scenario test development-toolchain-validator` with a valid manifest; assert Contracts phase is PASSED in the report
Manifest errors surface during the standard test pipeline, blocking broken scenarios from advancing to Standards review

title: Test-genie Contracts phase integration
